source: Forgiving Step by Step
target: Okusonyiwa Mumitendera

source: We all long for deep and loving relationships, but unfortunately all of us have experienced hurt and possibly even abuse by others. It is painful and we suffer from it. Just as physical wounds can become infected and fester, wounds in our heart can grow into bitterness if we don’t act. Time alone won’t heal!
target: Ffena tuyayanira okwagalwa n'omukwano og'omubuziba naye ekyenaku nti ffena tusisinkanye kulumizibwa era oba olyawo tukozesedwa abalala. Kiluma era tubonabona mukyo. Nga ebiwundu ebyomubuliwo bwebiyinza okulumbibwa obuwuka nebikosebwa, ebiwundu mumitima gyaffe bifuka obukawu singa tetubako kyetukora. Okukiwa obuwi obude kyoka tekimara era tekiwonya!

source: In response we often withdraw ourselves and build up walls as protection. As a result, we don’t allow anyone to get close to us and we become isolated. Alternatively, we react with anger, hold the mistakes against the other person, and seek revenge. This leaves our thoughts to be consumed with the hurt the other person caused us.
target: Mungeri ezimu tweyawula era netwezimbako ebisenge nga engeri ez'okwekuma, Ekivamu tetuganya muntu yena kutusemberera era tweyawula kubalala. Mungeri endala, tweyisa mungeri eyobusungu nga tuteka ensobi zaffe kubalala era netunonya okuwolela. Kino kiletera endowoza zaffe okumalibwawo n'obulumi obuletedwa omuntu omulala gyetuli.

source: By using these strategies, we try to protect ourselves from further misuse, but in the end we hurt ourselves even more. Furthermore, if we’re hurt we won’t treat others with love – Hurt people hurt people.
target: Nga tukozesa engeri zino, tugezako okwekuma okuva era okukozesebwa mungeri embi eziyinza okweyongera, naye munkomelelo twelumya n'okusingawo. Mukweyongerayo, bwetuba nga tukosedwa, tetusobola kuyisa balala nakwagala – abantu balumya abantu.

source: The only escape from this vicious cycle is forgiveness, which can be very hard if we have experienced significant pain. However, as long as we don’t forgive we stay bound to the person who hurt us and to the past. This is because we can’t just forget painful experiences and can only try to repress the memories. But God wants us to be free – free from bitterness, free from the desire for revenge, and free from the pain of the past.
target: Engeriyoka ey'okuva mukino kusonyiwa, ekiyinza okuba ekizibu singa tubanga twayita mubulumi bunji, naye ate singa tetusonyiwa tusigala nga tusibidwa ku muntu oyo eyatulumya neri ebyemabega, kubanga tetusobola kwelabila bwelabizi bulumi bwetwayitamu naye Mukama Katonda atwagala tube ba dembe, okuva eri obukawu, okuva eri okwagala okuwolera era n'okuva eri obulumi bw'ebyayita.

source: What is forgiveness?
target: Okusonyiwa kyeki?

source: Forgiveness is choosing to let go of all reproaches and accusations against the other person. I hand him/her into God’s hands. Rather than passing judgment myself, I trust God, who is the just judge, and let Him decide what will happen with the other person. It also means that I no longer count the other person’s sins against him or hold them over him. In other words, as I’m already living with the consequences of his sins and can’t change the past, I now make peace with this and release the other person from all his debts against me.
target: Okusonyiwa kwekusalawo okuta buli kunenya n'okunenyezebwa eri abalala, (Muteka mumikono gyamukana), okusinga okusala omusanga nze kenyini, nesiga Mukama omulamuzi omwenkanya, era Yye k'asalewo ekinatuka eri omuntu oyo. Okusonyiwa era kitegeza nti sikyamubalala bibi oba sikyamusako kibi kyona omuntu oyo eyanumya. Mungeri endala, nze nkyayina enkovu ku lw'okusobya kwe era sikyayinza kukyusa byamabega, kati nsalawo okukakana mudembe nakino era nsumulula omuntu oyo okuva eri bulibanja lyalina gyendi.

source: This is my decision alone. It is completely independent from the other person, whether he/she says sorry or not or whether he/she is present or not. We’re not dependent on the person who hurt us.
target: Kuno kuba kusalawo kwange nzeka, (tewali wekukwataganila na muntu oli yadde), oba omuntu oyo agya gyendi neyetonda oba nedda, oba wali oba taliwo, tetwesigama ku muntu eyatusobya nga tusonyiwa.

source: Though forgiving is good for the other person, first and foremost I do it for my own good. When we forgive, we become free from negative feelings like fear, anger, or bitterness and can then become healed and whole again.
target: Newankubade okusonyiwa kilunji eri omuntu oyo, naye ekisoka mubyona nkikola kulwobulunji bwange. Bwetusonyiwa, tufuka badembe okuva eri empulila enkyamu okugeza nga okutya, obusungu, oba obukawu era kunkomelelo tuwonyezebwa nate.

source: Steps of forgiving
target: Emitendera egy'okusonyiwa

source: Sometimes we take shortcuts when we hastily speak out forgiveness but later realize that there are still remnants of the pain in our hearts. So how can we fully forgive others? The following steps help us by leading us through the process of forgiving.
target: Ebisela ebimu tukuba panya bwetwanguyiliza okwogela nti tusonyiye naye oluvanyuma netukizula nga wakyaliwo obulumi obukyasigalide mumitima gyaffe. N'olwekyo, tuyinza tutya okusonyiwa ddala ddala abalal? Emitendera gyino gyituyamba nga gyituyisa okuyita mungeri eyokusonyiwa.

source: The first three steps we go through carefully, preferably together with a helper.
target: Emitendera essatu egyisoka tugyiyitemu n'obwegendereza, kyandisinze nyo nga oyina akuyambako.

source: 1. What happened?
target: 1. Kiki ekyatukawo?

source: * Describe specifically what happened. * Common mistake: We stay general and vague.
target: *Nyonyola ddala kiki ekyatukawo. *Ensobi ezabuligyo: Tusigale mubulambulukufu bw'akyo.

source: 2. What hurt me? How did I feel?
target: 2. Kiki ekyanumya? Mungeri kii?

source: * Feelings are important and a vital part of who we are. * Common mistake: We skip this step and just stick to the facts.
target: *Empulila zaffe zamugaso era zamuwendo kukiki kyetuli. *Ensobi ezabuligyo: Tubuke omutendera guno naye tusigale kukituffu.

source: 3. Name the sin
target: 3. Menya ekibi

source: * Don’t soften wrongs and don’t justify. Identify how the other person sinned against me through the things he did or did not do. * Common mistake: We justify the other person (but if we don’t call it sin there can’t be forgiveness).
target: *Tosusuta ebibi era togezako okubitukiliza. Manya engeri omuntu oli gyeyakusobyamu okuyita mubintu byeyakola oba by'atakola. *Ensobi ezabuligyo: Tutukiliza omuntu oli naye bwetutakiyita kibi tewasobola kubera kusonyiwa.

source: Now we go into prayer and bring everything to God.
target: Kati tugenda mukusaba era tulete bulikimu kyona eri Katonda.

source: 4. Bring charges of injustice to God
target: 4. Leta emisango egyo egy'obutali bwenkanya eri Katonda.

source: * We go to God the judge and bring charges against the person who hurt us. We pour out our heart to God and tell Him all the main points from the first three steps. * Common mistakes: We skip this step, or we hide our emotions from God.
target: *Tugenda eri Katonda omulamuzi era netuleta emisango gyetulina eri omuntu oyo eyatusobya, tuyuwa oba tugula emitima gyaffe eri Katonda era netumugamba ensonga enkulu okuva mumitendera essatu egyo. *Ensobi ezabuligyo: Tubuka omutendera guno oba tukweka empulila zaffe okuva eri Katonda.

source: 5. Speak out forgiveness
target: 5. Yogera nti osonyiwa.

source: * We now speak out forgiveness (“I forgive ___ for ___”) and make the decision to hand the whole case over into God’s hands. * Common mistakes: We tell God what to do with that person (we curse the other person). Or we say we want to forgive (“Lord, help me to forgive”) but don’t actually make the decision.
target: *Kati twatula nti tusonyiwa (“nsonyiwa ___ kulwa ___”) era tukola okusalawo okuteka ensonga zona mu mikono gya Katonda. *Ensobi ezabuligyo: Tutera okugamba Katonda kiki ky'ayina okukolela omuntu oyo (tukolimila omuntu oyo) oba tugamba nti twagala kusonyiwa (“Mukama nyamba nsonyiwe”) naye nga mumazima tetutwala kusalawo.

source: Bringing charges of injustice to God
target: Okuleta emisango egy'obutali bwenkanya eri Katonda.

source: God is the judge and we have the right to bring every injustice to Him. We can be certain He will bring justice and will judge everyone – that’s not our job. We have no right to pay back others or to take revenge on them.
target: Katonda yemulamuzi era tulina edembe okuleta bulibutari bwenkanya gy'ali. Tusobola okumwesiga nti agya kuleta obwenkanya era nga agya kulamula buly'omu, era ogo simulimu gwaffe. Tetulina dembe kuwolera.

source: In the same way as we bring charges to a judge in this world, we can bring charges to God. We don’t have to be afraid to offend Him, but we can be totally honest and show all our feelings. After we’re finished, we let go of the accusations and put everything into God’s hands. We don’t continue to judge the other person ourselves, but we leave the judgment to God alone.
target: Nga mungeri emu bwetuleta emisango gyaffe eri omulamuzi munsi eno, tusobola okuleta emisango eri katonda. Tetulina kutya nti tuyinza okumunyiza naye tusobola okubera abesimbu era netulaga empulila zaffe zonna. Nga tumaliliza, tulekula okunenyezebwa kwona era tuteka bulikimu kyona mumikono gya Katonda, tetweyongerayo nakusala musango naye tuleka okulamula eri Katonda yeka.

source: More hints
target: Okweyongerayo.

source: ;Using the support of a helper :It is hard to go through this whole process of forgiveness alone without overlooking some aspects. Look for someone who can go through these steps together with you and pray with you!
target: ;Nga tweyambisa omuyambi waffe :Kizibu okuyita mu mitendera gyino gyona egy'okusonyiwa ffeka na ffeka nga tulina ebintu ebimu byetutatunulide. Funayo omuntu asobola okuyita mumitendera gyino mwena era asabe nawe!

source: ;Our own sin :When we are hurt, we often unintentionally treat others badly and sin against them. It’s important not to ignore these things but to repent and ask forgiveness. Clarify anything that comes to your mind here as soon as possible!
target: ;Ebibi byaffe :Nga tulumizidwa, tuyisa bubi abalala mubugenderere era netusobya gy'ebali. Kyamuwendo obutaleka bintu binno wabula okwenenya era netusaba okusonyiyibwa. Kakasa bulikyona ekija eri endowoza yo mumangu ddala!

source: ;Forgiving myself :Sometimes we’re angry at ourselves or blame ourselves for something. God offers a way to forgive us and cleanse us through Jesus Christ. Forgiving myself means taking His offer and applying it to myself.
target: ;Okwesonyiwa :Ebisera ebimu twenyigira oba netwenenya ku lw'ebintu ebimu. Naye Mukama Katonda atusonyiwa era atutukuza mu Yesu Kristo. Okwesonyiwa kitegeza okukiliza okusonyiwa kwa Katonda okukola mu bulamu bwaffe.

source: ;“Forgiving” God :Sometimes we have negative thoughts about God or are even mad at Him. God doesn’t make mistakes, so in that sense we can’t forgive Him. But it is important that we let go of our frustrations and negative feelings towards Him.
target: ;“Okusonyiwa” Katonda :Ebisera ebimu tulina endowoza embi eri Katonda oba tufuka n'abalalu gy'ali. Katonda takola nsobi, n'olwekyo muntegera eyo tetusobola kumusonyiwa. Naye kyansonga ffe okuleka empulila zaffe embi eri YE “Katonda”.

source: ;Sticking to forgiveness :In case the old feelings come up again, remind yourself that you have already chosen to forgive and those feelings will pass. However, it is possible that there are other aspects or deeper layers of hurt that you did not address the first time. We can then go through the process of forgiving once again so that these areas get healed as well.
target: ;Okulemera ku kusonyiwa :Singa empulila zaffe enkade ziba nga zikomawo nate era, wejukize nti gwe wasazewo okusonyiwa era empulila ezo zijakuyita, naye ate waliwo okutebereza nti waliwo obulumi obw'omunda bw'otayanjula mukusokera dala. Awo tusobola okudamu nate emitendera gyino egy'okusonyiwa omulundi omulala ebifo bino bisobole okuwona nabyo.

source: Examining myself
target: Wekebere

source: Take 2 minutes to ask God the following question and make notes:
target: Twala edakika biri 2 okubuza Mukama ebibuuzo bino era bako by'owandika.

source: God, who do I need to forgive?
target: Mukama, ani gwenyina okusonyiwa?

source: Listen to God and go through your relationships (parents, family, relatives, friends, neighbors, colleagues, classmates, teachers, leaders, yourself, God, ...)
target: Wuliliza Katonda era wekenenye enkolaganayo (n'abazade, abenganda, amikwano, mililwanajo, b'osoma nabo, n'abasomesa, abakulembeze, n'awekenyini, ne Katonda,.....)

source: How was I hurt and by whom?
target: Nalumizibwa ntya era ani yanumya?

source: Hints for finding out whether the relationship with a certain person is healthy or still broken in some way: * Think about the person: Can you wish him/her all the best with all your heart? * Imagine you meet the person on the street: How would you feel? Are you still bearing a grudge?
target: Ebimu kungeri z'okuzula oba enkolagana n'omuntu omu nunji oba ekyali menyeffu mungeri emu oba endara. *Lowoza ku muntu oyo, osobola okumwagaliza ekilunji n'omutima go gonna? *Fumintiliza nga osisinkanye omuntu oyo mukubo, oyinza kuwulila otya?, okyayina obusungu?

source: Practice
target: Okwegezamu/okuteka munkola

source: Which hurts do I want to address first?
target: Bulumiki bwenandiyagade okwanjula mukusoka?

source: Who should support me in this? Clarify specifically how you will continue!
target: Ani ayinza okumpagila mukino? Kakasa ngeriki gy'oneyongera!
